review.template: Review this PR comprehensively: check correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. Use the codebase-memory context.

debug.template: Systematically debug this issue: reproduce, isolate, hypothesize, fix, verify. Use sequential-thinking if needed.

test.template: Generate comprehensive tests for the current changes. Include edge cases, error paths, and integration tests.

doc.template: Generate documentation for the current changes: update README, add inline docs, update API docs if applicable.

architect.template: Analyze the current codebase architecture. Identify patterns, anti-patterns, and suggest improvements. Do NOT make changes.

benchmark.template: Run a model benchmark: test the same task with claude-sonnet-4-20250514, gpt-4, and local. Compare quality, speed, and token usage.

dream.template: Execute /dream command: extract persistent knowledge from this session into project memory, remove outdated entries, and consolidate learnings.

distill.template: Execute /distill command: discover repeated manual workflows in recent work and package high-confidence candidates into reusable skills, subagents, or commands.

memory.template: Review and manage project memory: show current MEMORY.md contents, suggest cleanup of outdated entries, and verify memory consistency.

checkpoint.template: Create a checkpoint: save current session state, task progress, and context for later resumption.
